title: psiadia agathaeoides
intro: Psiadia agathaeoides, commonly known as African sage, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing stress and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Psiadia agathaeoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, relieve anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit immunomodulatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include terpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been identified and isolated from the plant's leaves and essential oil.
